'''Evan Lorentz''' is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>

== Radio Free Decipher ==
Lorentz co-hosted ''[[Radio Free Decipher]]'' with [[Kyle Heuer]] in 2002 and hosted later episodes himself. As a ''Star Trek'' CCG designer he discussed the ''Motion Pictures'' expansion, and he helped proofread the foreign-language ''Lord of the Rings'' TCG press sheets.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=docK2vpQWUI&t=36s Broadcast 112 - Radio Free Decipher (25 January, 2002): Scott Gaeta on the SWCCG PC], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 00:36. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-docK2vpQWUI Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 112 transcript]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8aNpe-I-KQk&t=1148s Broadcast 110 - Radio Free Decipher (11 January, 2002): SWCCG Player's Committee, ST/LOTR News], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 19:08. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8aNpe-I-KQk Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 110 transcript]].</ref>

== Austin Powers CCG ==
On a March 2002 episode of Radio Free Decipher, Lorentz said he had "a pretty heavy hand in the design" of Decipher's ''Austin Powers'' CCG. The same episode previewed the ''Star Trek'' CCG ''Motion Pictures'' expansion, for which he explained the renaming of the Excelsior icon as the Classic Films icon.<ref name="rfd119">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY&t=750s Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 12:30. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY&t=345s Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 05:45. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]].</ref>
